why: Kalshi WebSocket order books primary on a structurally orderless dedicated service. Kalshi documents no read-only API key class (docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/api_keys, 2026-10-08: Ed25519 or RSA keys, no scopes), so the boundary is the process: market_plane_guard locks it against venue writes, blocks every order-client module from import and refuses to run beside any order-capable credential. UNIVERSAL_MARKET_PLANE=off: the PMX plane is not moved by this service (no PMX credential, no stream from the firm-wide gRPC pool).
name: sportsassets-market-plane
